name: cure-spend-band
description: Shows today's GitHub Actions spend beside the spinner, warns under the prompt when the month is on pace to exceed the plan's included usage, and adds /spend. One gh fetch per machine every 15 minutes, kept in the machine store.

org.title: GitHub organization
org.description: The organization whose billing is read. CURE_SPEND_ORG overrides it.

allowanceUsd.title: Included Actions usage (USD/month)
allowanceUsd.description: The plan's monthly included Actions usage. CURE_SPEND_ALLOWANCE overrides it.

paceWarning.title: Pace warning line
paceWarning.description: Show the warning under the prompt when the month is on pace to exceed the allowance. /spend dismiss hides it for the month.
